target.role: Associate Director, Enterprise Model Risk Management

summary: Associate Director, Enterprise Model Risk Management candidate with ~7 years across model validation, quantitative model development, and risk analytics. Currently operates within Moody's Analytics' formal model-governance framework with delegated sign-off on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios. Hands-on Python and SQL practitioner; stochastic and Monte Carlo modelling foundations from dual MSc (Financial Modelling, Chemical Engineering); applied knowledge of OSFI E-23 and SR 11-7 validation standards. CFA charterholder.

sections.heading: Independent Model Validation & Challenge
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and risk outputs for multi-asset institutional client portfolios ranging $5–25bn per engagement; independently reviews curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions prior to production release.

Operates within a formal model-risk and governance framework — challenges assumptions, assesses economic and mathematical defensibility, and escalates outputs lacking quantitative support; maintains documentation standards consistent with SR 11-7 and OSFI E-23 expectations.
Validates derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation; cross-checks sensitivities and scenario impacts against benchmark calculations at portfolio-level aggregates.

sections.heading: Quantitative Model Development & Benchmark Analysis
bullets: Led design and implementation of a multi-scenario cash-flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios — embedded behavioural assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines under Git version control, with embedded logging, validation tests, and reconciliation against shadow runs to satisfy model-governance audit.

Built agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor IDE) automating code generation, validation scaffolding, and anomaly detection — reducing validation cycle time by an estimated 30–40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Validation Reporting & Stakeholder Recommendations
bullets: Prepared comprehensive model documentation and validation summaries for senior stakeholders covering scenario impacts, sensitivities, and methodology observations; serves as escalation point on client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.
Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe analytics platform; validated model outputs post-deployment.
Translated client investment-team requirements into structured Product Owner requests; advised on asset, liability, and risk-model configurations across the assigned book of accounts.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients — aligned regulatory requirements with system implementation and contributed to governance documentation and regulatory-readiness processes.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, and risk teams on milestone delivery, implementation materials, and control documentation.

Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators using Monte Carlo techniques and statistical calibration to assess interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk under base-case and stressed environments.

Performed VaR and CVaR portfolio optimization (asset-only and asset-liability surplus) on the GLASS platform; conducted risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk, and near-optimal-frontier robustness analysis for institutional clients.

Delivered ALM studies for Canadian and international pension funds — analyzed funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures; presented findings to investment committees on-site.

Led modelling and validation work for a three-plan university pension merger (JSPP) on a team of three — captured all Funding Policy dynamics and tested duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
